note: This file is a pure configuration file (MMSegmentation/MMDet-style). It contains only variable assignments and dict literals — no functions, classes, or callable APIs. It is loaded by an external training framework (e.g., MMEngine) to configure a Sapiens MAE pretraining run.
run_mae_pretraining: run the sapiens 1b MAE pretraining on Humans300M dataset for 1600 epochs using this config file

review_optimizer_config: review the AdamW optimizer config with gradient clipping and param-wise weight decay settings
review_lr_scheduler: review the LinearLR warmup and CosineAnnealingLR scheduler spanning 1600 epochs
